## Disposition

Accept five corrected scoped partial results for target 30005735. The 5/5 substantive-approach budget is exhausted; no sixth approach, full switching-BV solution, full-source counterexample, global viscous approximation, or novelty claim is made.

The common-scanning construction retains its coherent compact common-band hypotheses. The source bridge includes smooth-part conditions as well as jump endpoints. Profile acceptance is wavewise. The thin-pulse obstruction is constitutive rather than a sequence of conservative PDE solutions. The C2 entropy obstruction keeps its boundary regularity. The countable local flat-scanning construction is restricted to 0<t<=1.

## Corrections and reproducibility

The accepted corrected report and both mathematical checkers are copied exactly. The authored historical correction patch and full independent audit are included. Original float contamination and optimization-disabled assertions are labeled historical; the superseded full report/checker, source bodies, datasets and private coordination are excluded.

Square-root rows are explicitly numerical illustrations. Separate exact rational certificates and a semantic output guard distinguish them from exact arithmetic. Reintroducing float contamination can exit 0 in the small checker; the independent exact-output guard rejects its non-rational flat-scanning results. Doubled H and injected float increments fail the intended conditions in all three modes.

Fresh final controls passed in normal, -O and -OO with actual UID=EUID=1000, files 0444, directory 0555, 47 physical whole-delivery write denials, and 14 mathematical-fixture denials per mode. Per mode: 11 intended mathematical negatives, 63 integrity negatives, 79 schema/scope negatives, 43 direct-comparator negatives, and hostile-environment complete-baseline equality. Full stdout/stderr comparisons are byte-for-byte, recursively type-exact and unnormalized. Whole-delivery and mathematical-fixture hashes are unchanged.

Pre-seal receipts are explicitly labeled and covered by the final manifest. Final fixed-bootstrap receipts are external to the delivery to avoid self-reference. Source-body replay, historical original-report/checker/harness replay, historical patch application, dataset replay and formal proof-assistant verification are NOT_RUN.
